description:
OTP json.erl's decoder (value/stack/acc continuation shape) fails to compile. run/build: 'native attempted to materialize absent value as runtime value with ty None'; interp: 'backend value was absent and cannot be materialized'. Blocks the whole decoder even with every other gap stripped. Reproducer (28 lines, delta-debugged): /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/punch/01_backend_absent_value_cps.fz

Part of fz-mue (fz runs OTP's json.erl unchanged). Port and harness: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/.
title: A continuation-passing decoder compiles: no absent value is materialized
